sourceSentences: [0] Um same with Kalista. If Kalista has a really strong engage support, she's super threatening, but if she doesn't, she can't really close the gap into you that well.
[0] You kind of will lose push sometimes and you'll have to give over ground, but sometimes you will be able to win push, right?
[1] Be careful to not be hit with Pierce(Q). as well as a Rend(E) used with minions!
[2] Be careful of Jhin’s Dancing Grenade(Q) that bounces off minions as well as his fourth basic attack! If Jhin stands in range while he is reloading, use Rend [E] to punish him.
[3] Jhin jest dość dużym zagrożeniem przez to jak bezpiecznie można nim grać i uniemożliwiać engage Kaliście. Dysponuje rootem, slowem (co dla kalisty jest zabójstwem) oraz przewyższa ją obrażeniami
